# scripts/mutation-pr.sh sets the worker count of gremlins: MUTATION_WORKERS, or one worker for each four cores.
# Only gremlins, timeout and getconf are stubs. The stub gremlins writes its arguments to args.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:git] skip
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
env GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
chmod 755 fake/gremlins
chmod 755 fake/timeout
chmod 755 fake/getconf
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH

exec git init -q -b main repo
cp a.go repo/a.go
cp gomod repo/go.mod
script mutation-pr.sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
exec git -C repo add a.go go.mod scripts
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b change
cp a2.go repo/a.go
exec git -C repo add a.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m change

# MUTATION_WORKERS wins over the core count, and the other arguments of the run stay.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/clean.json
env FAKE_CORES=16
env MUTATION_WORKERS=3
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep ' --workers 3 \.$' args
grep ' --diff main ' args
grep '^unleash ' args

# With no MUTATION_WORKERS, the run starts one worker for each four cores.
env MUTATION_WORKERS=
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep ' --workers 4 \.$' args

# A host with fewer than four cores still gets one worker.
env FAKE_CORES=3
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep ' --workers 1 \.$' args

# The print mode gives the number that make mutation passes to gremlins.
env FAKE_CORES=32
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh --print-workers
stdout '^8$'
env MUTATION_WORKERS=2
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh --print-workers
stdout '^2$'

# A worker count that is not a positive whole number stops the run before gremlins starts.
env MUTATION_WORKERS=0
exitcode 2 sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: MUTATION_WORKERS is "0"\. Set it to a positive whole number of workers, such as 4\.$'
env MUTATION_WORKERS=many
exitcode 2 sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: MUTATION_WORKERS is "many"\.'
! stdout '^the stub gremlins started$'

-- gomod --
module example.com/r

go 1.27
-- a.go --
package a
-- a2.go --
package a

func F(x int) bool { return x > 0 }
-- fake/gremlins --
#!/bin/sh
echo "the stub gremlins started"
echo "$*" > "$WORK/args"
cp "$GREMLINS_REPORT" "$5"
-- fake/timeout --
#!/bin/sh
shift 3
exec "$@"
-- fake/getconf --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$FAKE_CORES"
-- clean.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
